SPARK attended DTF Conference 2026 in Malta

13-14 October 2026

The SPARK team attended DTF Conference 2026 at Valletta Gateway Terminal, joining discussions on the transition from shore power to integrated energy systems.

The consortium also held its General Assembly in Malta, bringing project partners together to coordinate the next phase of technical, operational and regulatory work.
